name: Whispers of the Eyeless
description:
In Whispers of the Eyeless, you are not merely a wanderer — you are a force of change. Build your cult in the depths of the city, gather followers in the name of Wrath, Desire, or Madness, and carve out a sanctuary amidst the ruin and intrigue. Each night, you venture into the city's crumbling districts, navigating treacherous encounters and unraveling secrets that shape the very soul of Aranthor. Will you be a savior, a scourge, or something far beyond mortal comprehension?

The city of Aranthor does not welcome the weak. It is a place where whispers carry the weight of prophecy, where gods long thought dead still stir in the shadows, and where a single choice can shift the course of fate.

Turn-based combat, strategy, and base-building intertwine in this dark fantasy RPG, offering a world where every decision lingers long after the deed is done. The gods are watching. The city is waiting. And the whispers… they never truly fade.

                            STRIKE WITH PRECISION, SURVIVE THE COST

Victory in Aranthor is about the cost, not just the outcome. Every encounter tests your resourcefulness and strategy as you balance ambition with survival.

  • Plan Every Move: Engage in tactical, turn-based combat that rewards foresight and precision.

  • Sanity and Strength: Harness the power of the Dead Gods carefully — each battle takes a toll on your health and mind.

  • Victory with Consequences: Triumph brings resources and influence, while failure weakens your grip on the city. Every choice has lasting effects.

                           INFILTRATE ARANTHOR AND COMMAND ITS FATE

Aranthor is a city on the brink of collapse, divided by power struggles, hidden dangers, and ancient secrets. As the First Prophet, infiltrate its fractured districts to gather resources, forge alliances, bring about the rise of the Dead Gods.

  • Old Town: The crowded streets offer resources and connections, but suspicion grows fast. Balance opportunity with caution as you expand your influence.

  • The Dungeons: Beneath the city lies a labyrinth of peril and reward. Unearth cursed relics and forbidden knowledge, but beware of ambushes and traps.

  • The High City: Aranthor’s elite hold sway over its future. Outwit and manipulate them, but tread carefully — betrayal is the price of power.

                           FATE’S MIRROR: TEST YOUR SKILL, DEFY THE ODDS

For players seeking endless challenges, Fate’s Mirror distills the game’s mechanics into high-stakes roguelite gameplay.

  • Dynamic Runs: Procedurally generated scenarios ensure fresh challenges every time.

  • Unlockable Shards: Earn powerful modifiers that redefine strategies and unlock new playstyles.

  • Endless Replayability: Procedural and handcrafted elements combine for unique, ever-evolving challenges.

                            GROW YOUR CULT: GUIDE YOUR FOLLOWERS

Your followers are your greatest weapon against the Living Gods. As the First Prophet, recruit disciples, train them, and lead them to fulfill the will of the Dead Gods.

  • Recruit and Train: Expand your cult by bringing in believers, each with unique traits. Train them to face the challenges ahead.

  • Assign Missions: Send disciples into Aranthor to gather resources, weaken rivals, or spread your influence.

  • Perform Rituals: Unite your cult in rituals to gain blessings from the Dead Gods. Their faith powers your rise — but draws the attention of the Living Gods.

  • Manage Loyalty: Keep your followers inspired, or risk dissent spreading through your ranks.

                          BUILD YOUR SANCTUM: THE HEART OF YOUR POWER

Hidden beneath Aranthor, your Sanctum is the center of your operations. Design and expand this base to amplify your strength and outmaneuver your enemies.

  • Customize and Expand: Unlock and upgrade rooms like the Reliquary for relics or the Hall of Faith for training disciples. Customize your Sanctum to reflect your chosen god — Wrath, Desire, or Madness.

  • Strategic Planning: Grow your base purposefully. Every addition offers new tools and abilities, from crafting cursed relics to conducting powerful rituals.

  • Risk and Reward: A larger Sanctum grants greater power, but risks exposure to the Living Gods.

                                                     PLAY YOUR WAY

Whether you’re drawn to deep narrative exploration, tactical combat, or cult management, Whispers of the Eyeless adapts to your playstyle. Adjustable difficulty ensures a rewarding experience for both newcomers and seasoned strategists.
